description.zh: EIP的带宽峰值，默认值为5。取值范围：5~10000，单位：Mbps。
description.en: The peak bandwidth of the EIP. Default value: 5. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 5 to 10000.

description.zh:
保证请求幂等性，避免多次重试带来重复操作的问题。

- 从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符 。

- 当您使用了一个已经使用过的ClientToken，其他请求参数无变化，那么重复提交该请求后，客户端将收到与首次提交相同的结果，对您的服务端状态没有影响

- 在接口超时或者错误码为PROCESSING的时候可以发起重试，幂等有效。返回结果是200 HTTPCode时，重试后客户端可以得到与上次相同的结果，但对您的服务端状态没有影响；返回结果是4xx HTTPCode时，且错误码不是PROCESSING则幂等无效。

- ClientToken有效期为10分钟。
description.en:
A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. This prevents duplicate operations if you retry the request.

- You can generate a unique, case-sensitive string that contains only ASCII characters and is no more than 64 characters in length.

- If you use a previously used client token with the same request parameters, the server returns the same result as the original request without changing its state.

- You can safely retry requests that time out or return a `PROCESSING` error code. Idempotence is guaranteed if the original request was successful (HTTP status code `200`). However, it is not guaranteed if the original request failed with an HTTP `4xx` error code other than `PROCESSING`.

- The token is valid for 10 minutes.
The ID of the edge node.

description.zh: EIP的计费方式，当前取值仅支持**PostPaid**（月按量计费）。
description.en: The billing method of the EIP. The value is set to **PostPaid**, which is the pay-as-you-go billing method.
The ID of the EIP instance.

description.zh: EIP的计费方式，当前取值仅支持**95BandwidthByMonth**（月95带宽计费）。
description.en: The metering method of the EIP. The value is set to **95BandwidthByMonth**, which indicates the monthly 95th percentile bandwidth metering method.
The IP address. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically allocates an available IP address.

description.zh:
运营商信息，取值：

- **cmcc**：中国移动。
- **unicom**：中国联通。
- **telecom**：中国电信。
description.en:
The ISP. Valid values:

- **cmcc**: China Mobile

- **unicom**: China Unicom

- **telecom**: China Telecom
The name of the EIP instance.

description.zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围为**1**~**20**。

- 不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或`https://`开头。
- 最多支持64个字符。
- 不允许传入空字符串。
description.en:
The key of tag N that is added to the instance. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

- The tag key cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`.

- The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length.

- The tag key cannot be an empty string.

description.zh: 标签值。不可超过128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.zh:
- API调用频率：5000次/秒。
- 单用户调用频率：50次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- API call rate: 5,000 requests per second.

- Single-user call rate: 50 requests per second.
